column3: Architectural Model developed in accordance to specified architectural design.
Architectural Model files are named according to the PWD’s BIM Guidelines and Standards
Architectural Model is structured according to rules that are easily managed. For example, architectural model is managed according to block, tower and podium.
Architectural Model to be positioned appropriately to the Project Base Point preferably Grid A and 1.
Architectural Model should be properly organised and using architectural gridlines and levels.
All materials are included in model elements.
Views (Architectural) created based from PWD’s architectural template.
WIP views are used for design development and design study purposes.
PBT views are used for PBT submission purposes.
BOMBA views are used for BOMBA submission purposes.
Dokumen views are used for contract documentation, contract implementation and final completion.
Spatial and Zoning Analysis are generated from Area Plan.
Contents of Legends are managed as follows: a) Legends for Components b) General Notes
Schedules/Quantities shall be generated according to: a) Schedule of Accomodation b) Building Component Schedule c) Material Takeoff Schedule

Contents of Sheets are architectural drawings that are managed according to the rules for architecture as follows: a) Title Block b) Drawing Title c) List of Drawings d) General Notes e) Plans f) Elevations g) Sections h) Details i) Others: _________________
All architectural drawings should use JKR Title Block with furnished information.
Files for the models linked with Architectural Model are correct and up-to-date
